data.one_liner: Camera and microphone streaming library via RTMP for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing camera and microphone streaming via RTMP for Android, iOS, and macOS. It supports multi-streaming, publish and playback, and video mixing with custom texts or bitmaps.
use_when: You need to stream live camera and microphone audio/video via RTMP on mobile or desktop.
You require multi-streaming to separate services simultaneously.
You need video mixing features like watermarking or text display during broadcasts.
avoid_when: You need a stable, production-ready streaming solution immediately and are in a hurry.
You are looking for general-purpose local camera capture without RTMP streaming.
strengths: Provides video mixing capabilities for watermarks and text overlays.
weaknesses: Development progresses slowly and the author recommends alternative plugins if you need something stable.
Technical support on issues and discussions is restricted to sponsors and contributors.
data.setup_notes: Requires Swift Package Manager and Xcode 26+ for Apple platforms. Android apps need compileSdk 37+. Requires camera and microphone usage permissions in Info.plist and audio-input/camera entitlements on macOS.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard local camera capture and preview without RTMP streaming functionality.
